title: view.columns / view.sort / view.tabs repeater row properties show English column heads in every locale — the #17508 ruling-A landing for the three view repeaters
body:
Filing gate: **③ a task the maintainer directed.** The maintainer's words, in the chat of session `session_019c3Hi6ZMU1p6m6aA6Bz45d` while handing over PR #19917 for landing: 「合并后还要补一张本地化跟进卡」. It is also a class (a) defect from the #17507 round (report `5800494895`).
Hand that acts: the next `domain:spec` claim, dispatched in the shape ruling A of #17508 already settled (below).
Dedupe (including closed), run by the filing seat: `view repeater columns sort tabs row properties localization view.form.ts metadataForms titles English Studio` → 2 hits (#8042, #5084; neither is this); `repeater-row-properties view enumerates no repeater row properties translation` → 4 hits (#17507, closed by PR #19917 — the titles half; #17508, closed by PR #19345 — the ruling, which fenced these three repeaters out; #17506 and #17505 — sibling carriers, done). No open card covers it.

## The defect

PR #19917 (merged as `f5a7250b7a`) gave the row items of `view.columns` (14 properties), `view.tabs` (9) and `view.sort` (2) an English JSON Schema title. `packages/spec/src/ui/view.form.ts` enumerates no row children for these three repeaters. So `os i18n extract` emits no `metadataForms.view.fields` key for any of the 25 row properties, and Studio in `zh-CN` / `ja-JP` / `es-ES` now shows the new **English** titles as the column heads. Before the merge those heads were raw keys.

`packages/platform-objects/src/apps/translations/repeater-row-properties.test.ts` still asserts that `view` is OUTSIDE its population ("view enumerates no repeater row properties yet"). That pin is the one to flip.

## Already ruled — the dispatch shape is inherited, not re-asked

#17508 ruling A (decision batch #120 item 3, maintainer 「17508 A AI负责翻译就行」): one coherent landing — the `*.form.ts` child enumeration **plus** all four catalogs (`en` + AI-authored `zh-CN` / `ja-JP` / `es-ES`) in the same PR, each child's `label` equal to the item schema's own `.meta({ title })`. PR #19345 applied that ruling to fifteen carriers and fenced these three out to #17507 (report `5749897882`: 「#17507 must add the leaves with the titles」). This card is that remainder.

Expected landing: `packages/spec/src/ui/view.form.ts` (25 row children), the four translation catalogs, and the `repeater-row-properties.test.ts` population (`view` moves inside it; the test's last case — a translated leaf is never an `en` echo — then covers these leaves too). Reuse the catalog's existing renderings, as PR #19345's review record did.
